title: Low Latency Network
name: low-latency-network
modal: This tunes the Windows network stack for the lowest possible ping: it removes the network throttling cap, prioritises networking over background tasks, disables receive-side coalescing and speeds up TCP handshakes. Revert restores Windows defaults.
description: Aggressive but safe network tuning for the lowest ping and smoothest online play
deepDescription:
A focused, fully reversible set of network tweaks aimed squarely at latency:

- NetworkThrottlingIndex → Unlimited (removes the 10 packets/ms cap)
- SystemResponsiveness → 10 (gives networking/multimedia priority over background work)
- Receive Segment Coalescing → Disabled (less buffering, lower latency)
- TCP Initial RTO → 1000 ms (faster connection setup and retransmits)
- Nagle's algorithm disabled (TcpAckFrequency=1, TCPNoDelay=1, TcpDelAckTicks=0)
- TCP Autotuning → Normal, RSS + ECN enabled, timestamps disabled

Revert restores every value to its Windows default. Nothing here can break your connection — it only changes how packets are handled.
